card.name: Comma after a year or data source
card.fires_on: The comma (or small linking word) right after an opening phrase naming a year or a statistics source, just before a count or figure is given. Seen in 'In 2010,' and 'based on laboratory data,'.

modes.label: After a year
modes.description: Comma following 'In' plus a year or 'that same year', before a statistic.

modes.label: After a data source
modes.description: Comma or bracket closing a phrase about data or a source, before the number of patients or cases.
modes.example: based on laboratory data<<,>> 44% of patients receiving E

card.writes: It favors words for statistical measures such as median, gross, weighted and same-period, and for rankings.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a sentence is about to give a statistic for a given year or from a given source.
